Name: T3 Linkpearl
Author: Kim
Punchline: Your T3 Code linkpearl inside FFXIV.
Description: Adds a floating linkpearl that opens the real T3 Code web client inside FFXIV. Uses Browsingway's off-screen Chromium renderer.
Changelog: Initial testing release: draggable T3 linkpearl, attached animated browser, inactivity dimming, settings, and thread-status badges.
